implementation_changes.supplement_route: Added an append-only SupplementRoute binding a W25 request/result to the target Claim, pre-supplement assessment, base and continuation W16 revisions, base and continuation W27 Dossiers, and any required W23 S8 re-selection.
implementation_changes.same_root_guard: A STRENGTHENED outcome requires a stronger relation and at least one independent root absent from the prior assessment. Duplicate same-root evidence remains ineligible for a strength claim.
implementation_changes.handoff: The route records MAINTAINED, STRENGTHENED, WEAKENED, UNRESOLVED, PAUSE_SOURCE or RETURN_TO_T03_S8, preserves before/after relations and new evidence/root IDs, and never grants automatic strength or publication.

positive_checks.maintained: New Evidence and the same bounded support relation are recorded as MAINTAINED, with downstream review recheck required.
positive_checks.strengthened: A second independent root moves PARTIALLY_SUPPORTS to SUPPORTS, creates a new W16 revision and W27 Dossier, and still records automatic_strength_granted=false.
positive_checks.weakened: New Evidence moves the relation to CONTRADICTS and routes to a bounded WEAKENED handoff.
positive_checks.unresolved: No qualifying new evidence remains UNRESOLVED and requires a new trigger before retry.
positive_checks.source_unavailable: Unavailable source stops the affected route with an explicit pause reason.
positive_checks.scope_change: Object/scope change creates a new revision/Dossier and returns to a current descendant W23 S8 decision.

negative_checks.same_root: A duplicate lineage root cannot be counted as strengthening.
negative_checks.retry: No-new-evidence and source-unavailable routes require a new trigger; repeated searching is not treated as stronger support.
negative_checks.s8: Changed object/scope without a new current W23 decision is rejected.
negative_checks.automatic_pass: The route cannot create READY/PASS or publication authorization.

controlled_binding_refresh.reason: The new W38 implementation/test files and technical implementation summaries changed the conservative managed-file and design binding contexts. All 21/59 bindings were explicitly reviewed; no W/G progress or evidence was reset.

limits: The route and both Dossiers use owned synthetic material, not a real discovered gap or real acquired supplement.
Only the manual supplement method is accepted; GPT Researcher and local conditional adapters are not adopted or validated.
W16/W27 continuation is offline; persistent checkpoint and production failure recovery remain unverified.
W31 review rechecks are required by the route but no real independent content review was performed.
W23/W25/W27/W31 and all formal prerequisites remain IN_PROGRESS or unaccepted.
